# Greenhoof Hooffield

[![Greenhoof as “Hooffield Yarn-Spinner” in the mobile game](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/mlp-gameloft/images/0/00/Hooffield_Yarn-Spinner_Character_Image.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20230815184922)](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Hooffield_Yarn-Spinner)

Greenhoof is the peach-pink Earth-pony mare with a dark rust-red mane among Ma Hooffield’s quarrelsome relatives in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. She is easiest to remember as the Hooffield whom Ma corrects for overloading a tomato slingshot during the family feud.

- **Appearance:** Peach/salmon coat, deep red mane, orange-brown eyes, and a notably angular muzzle. The [G4 mare index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) identifies her with the Hooffields of the Smokey Mountains.
- **Names:** “Greenhoof” is **spoken in the television episode** by Ma Hooffield; “Greenhoof Hooffield” is the full identification used by character indexes. Gameloft’s licensed mobile game instead calls this mare **“Hooffield Yarn-Spinner”**, a profession-style game label, not a secret identity. Its description jokes that she spins both stories and textiles.
- **Speaking and appearances:** She has **no individually verified spoken line or voice-actor credit**; Ma addresses her, but Greenhoof does not answer. Her verified animated appearance is **“The Hooffields and McColts” (S5E23, 2015)**. The game also includes her as a playable/helper character in its Hooffields-and-McColts content.
- **Fan artwork:** [Chub-Wub’s eyebrow-themed pony ensemble](https://twibooru.org/3399395) includes Greenhoof among many characters; the linked post provides attribution and the original-source reference.

## Important moments

1. **Too many tomatoes — “The Hooffields and McColts” (S5E23):** Ma Hooffield tells Greenhoof to load one tomato at a time, directly establishing her first name and her involvement in the feud. [Episode transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=64746); exact video timestamp unavailable.
2. **The feud finally ends — “The Hooffields and McColts” (S5E23):** Following Fluttershy’s account of the valley’s ruined habitat, the Hooffields and McColts agree to stop fighting and cooperate; this resolves Greenhoof’s family conflict, though she has no separately attributed decision or dialogue. [Licensed full episode](https://www.nowtv.com/watch/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/iYEQYZ6ymh22BCLb91Vd3m/seasons/5/episodes/the-hooffields-and-mccolts-episode-23/A5EK3JYiLcaCh73faTg5U); exact timestamp unavailable.

*Image credit: Gameloft/Hasbro’s licensed mobile-game character rendering, reproduced via the linked game-character page; no individual artist is verified.*
